name: Arcadia Fallen II
source:
Seven years after the dramatic events in Anemone Valley, the political situation surrounding magic has reached a boiling point within the Empire. At Seven Winds Academy, however, life goes on undisturbed by outside influences. Here, the students’ biggest worries are exams, job prospects, and who might be taking whom to the New Year’s Gala, but when a curious group of seniors stumbles upon a secret hidden within the castle, their priorities for the year change in an instant...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924070/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
海葵谷的戏剧性事件发生七年后，帝国内部围绕魔法的政治局势已经达到了沸点。然而，在七风学院，生活依然不受外界影响。在这里，学生们最担心的是考试、就业前景，以及谁可能带谁去参加新年晚会，但当一群好奇的学长们偶然发现城堡中隐藏的秘密时，他们今年的优先事项瞬间发生了变化……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924070/]Steam[/url]]
